request.description: One native pixel art fantasy enemy STILL for Dungeon Matcher, full body three-quarter combat stance looking slightly viewer-left, transparent background. Crisp ONE-source-pixel #0A0D11 contours, NO antialias, gradient, dithering, grain, text, ground shadow or scenery. Broad connected 2-3-tone top-left shaded material shapes; compact whimsical expressive identity. Keep every extremity inside 2-pixel side margins. Matte charcoal/navy iron, muted leather, small brass, luminous orange ONLY in ore sockets. Thin compact DWARF rail foreman, short black practical beard, navy-black coat, rail cap, opaque green goggles and leather gloves. Holds a chunky mechanical BUTTON CONTROLLER in both hands, clearly visible big square amber/red buttons, dial, gear and little lever. Ready hand hovers over button. Short legs, sly alert posture. NOT phone, tablet, book, wizard, giant lever or gun.
